title: A Blue Hour for the Undertow
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Beatrix Sandoval, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
